A Day AtMarbella's

One café, one whole day, from the first filter coffee at half past ten to the last dessert at eleven.

Rated 4.2 ★ across 3,191 Google reviews · around ₹1,000 for two · and now keeping a second day at Elgin 2.0 on Woodburn Road.

Begin the Day Get Directions

The day begins

10:30AM

Doors open

First light, first coffee.

The doors come up on a leafy lane off Golpark, and the glass roof does the rest, the courtyard fills with light, the tree wakes up, and the first cups land on white tables. Marbella's began as a garage in 2019; mornings are still its favourite hour.

Breakfast runs all day here, because nobody should be rushed before noon, or after it, honestly.

The courtyard fills

The long lunch.

lunch here has never once ended on time

3:30PM

The lull

The slow hours.

The counter at half past three , the café's best-kept secret

Lunch has drifted out, dinner is hours away. This is when the laptops open, work-friendly WiFi, corners made for long chapters and longer conversations, and something cold from the counter while the courtyard sits quiet.

5:45PM

The light turns

Golden hour.

Late light comes through the glass roof at an angle and the whole room changes temperature, the mustard alcoves glow, the paper flowers catch fire, and every table suddenly looks like the good table.

The mustard alcoves · 5:45 PM

The same courtyard, seven hours later

7:30PM

The lights come on

Dinner, as the sky gives up.

Outside, Gariahat is all headlights. Inside, the fairy lights take over from the sun and the kitchen turns to the long plates, pasta, mash, a khow suey worth crossing the city for.

9:30PM

Meanwhile, across town

The day, twice over.

Seven years after a garage in Hindustan Park, there's a second home now, Marbella's Elgin 2.0, opened October 2026 on Woodburn Road. Sunlit white walls, sandy beige, seashell details, the same slow warmth, keeping its own hours across town.
